hotel.name: Harbor Light Hotel
hotel.check_in: Check-in starts at 3:00 PM. Early check-in may be available on request and is subject to room availability.
hotel.check_out: Check-out is by 11:00 AM. Late check-out can be requested at reception and may include an additional charge.
hotel.breakfast: Breakfast is served daily from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM in the Seabreeze Restaurant. Continental breakfast is included with Deluxe, Family, and Suite bookings. Standard rooms can add breakfast for 900 INR per guest.
hotel.wifi: Complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi is available in all guest rooms, meeting spaces, and public areas.
hotel.parking: Self-parking is available for 500 INR per night. Valet parking is available for 900 INR per night.
hotel.pool: The outdoor pool is open from 6:00 AM to 9:00 PM. Children under 14 must be accompanied by an adult.
hotel.gym: The fitness center is open 24 hours for registered guests using their room key.
hotel.restaurant: Seabreeze Restaurant serves breakfast from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM, lunch from 12:30 PM to 3:00 PM, snacks from 4:00 PM to 6:00 PM, and dinner from 7:00 PM to 10:30 PM. Room service is available from 6:30 AM to 11:00 PM.
hotel.reception: Reception is staffed 24 hours a day. Guests can call extension 0 from any hotel phone.
hotel.pet_policy: Pets are not allowed, except certified service animals.

rooms.name: Standard Room
rooms.description: A quiet room for one or two guests with essential comforts.

rooms.name: Deluxe Room
rooms.description: A larger room for up to three guests with a marina-facing sitting area.
rooms.bed_config: 1 king bed and 1 rollaway bed on request

rooms.name: Family Room
rooms.description: A spacious room designed for families or small groups.

rooms.name: Harbor Suite
rooms.description: A premium suite with a separate living room and harbor view.

policies.cancellation: Flexible bookings can be cancelled without charge until 24 hours before arrival. Late cancellations and no-shows are charged the first night's room rate. Non-refundable rates cannot be cancelled or changed.
policies.check_in: Guests must present a government-issued photo ID and booking confirmation at check-in.
policies.check_out: Guests should settle incidental charges before check-out. Express check-out is available.
policies.extra_guests: Extra guests must be declared before arrival. Rollaway beds are available only in Deluxe rooms and Suites, subject to availability.
policies.children: Children under 6 stay free when using existing bedding. Cribs are available on request at no extra charge.
policies.pets: Pets are not allowed, except certified service animals.
